definitions.full: H5724. Adlay עַדְלָ֑י proper name, masculine 1Chr 27:29 , ᵐ5 . Αδαι , ᵐ5 L Αδλι . II. עדל (√ of foll.; compare Arabic turn aside , whence עֲדֻלָּם = retreat, refuge , so Lag BN 54, compare Dr Sm. p. 293 Bhul Geogr. 97 ).
